title: Fantastic Wine and Tapas Tour of Seville
text:
Rosie Was the most perfect guide - mixing humour with lots of information, both factual and fun.
The food was fantastic and the drink flowed as we wended our way through the streets of Seville, Tapas by Tapas.
Seville is only 1 1/2 hours away for us so we will definitely be back.
John and Pauline Connor

title: Tapas review
text: Went with my wife who is a vegetarian. Our host Rosie arranged for alternative food choices. She was wonderful, outgoing, fun and knowledgeable about the food, drinks and history. Rosie rocks! Wonderful experience.

title: Great evening
text: Great fun evening, allowed is to see parts of Seville we wouldn’t have otherwise seen. Enjoyed Steph’s company
author: Vicki J

title: On of the best food tours ever!
text: One of the best food tours we’ve ever done!  Our guide Jeff, was fabulous!  Took us to some of his favorite local places, plus, he’s a chef, so the food and wine were great!  Tried things we may not have thought to order if we’d been on our own.  Two other couples from the UK completed our group, and we all hit it off, and had so much fun!  This is what I love about traveling!  Highly recommend booking this tour and ask for Jeff!
author: Sue4LSU

title: Gourmet food and tapas tour
text: We had an excellent time with Jeremy who showed us some great spots slightly off the beaten track. Food and drinks was first class and Jeremy's knowledge and obvious passion for both food and Seville shone through. Excellent value and would highly recommend this experience.
